specific_gaps: ORIGINAL:EO:13326 §6(b), chars 5181-5266, makes Commission termination occur within 60 days after actual final-report submission. The dossier contains no report-transmission date or actual termination instrument/date; §5 deadline (chars 4618-4780) is not evidence of actual submission or an end. EO:13385 §3 acknowledges committees already terminated or completed and cannot establish the earliest end.

Dossier missing list affirmatively flags target provision not located: EO:13349. No EO:13349 text/context is held in this dossier, so its possible alteration of reporting or termination terms cannot be resolved.

ORIGINAL:EO:13328 §8, chars 10829-10925, terminates the Commission within 60 days after actual report submission. The dossier lacks submission/transmission and exact termination evidence; §2(d) March 31, 2005 reporting deadline (chars 4454-5260) cannot substitute for the actual trigger or establish an exact earlier end.

ORIGINAL:EO:13328 §2(d) separately directs Intelligence Community use of the resulting report (chars 5261-5401) and presidential consultation/proposals within 90 days after receipt (chars 5402-5670). Commission termination alone does not establish first ends for these independent commands; actual receipt/completion or other cessation evidence is absent.
